## 2700 - 2736

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02700">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2700 Flowing parameters check (high-high low-low)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02700">

FLOWCAL supports 'High-High' and 'Low-Low' limits for additional flowing parameter validations with appropriate exception descriptions. A 'Max Unresolved Severity' can be tracked in the Final Form Tables. By setting the severity of these exceptions to an elevated level, the exports and downstream systems can examine the Max Severity Value and determine if a record is ready to be processed. Any unresolved High-High or Low-Low exceptions present will prevent the meter data from being sent downstream.

If a High and High-High or Low and Low-Low limit are both exceeded, FLOWCAL will only generate a single exception for either the High-High or the Low-Low. An exception will not be generated for the High or Low limit being exceeded.

 

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02701">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2701 FPC - Low-low volume</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02701">

This exception is generated when a record’s Volume exceeds the user defined limit for minimum volume. For example, the minimum volume is set to 100.0000, but the meter’s volume is calculated at 90.0000.

</div>

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2736 FPC - High S&amp;W volume correlation factor</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02736">

This exception is generated when a record’s SWV Correlation Factor exceeds the user defined limit for maximum correlation factor. For example, the maximum correlation factor is set to 1.005, but the SWV Correlation Factor is calculated at 1.01.
